items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So they let Andy take the band over... we formed this band... T. Holder had formed the Twelve Clouds of Joy; Kirk was the bass player... Yeah, because that's after he had left Andy Kirk... so he used it with us, Twelve Clouds of Joy.

ctx.x: So they let Andy take the band over because he was the most logical man. He had finished from the University, he had gone down to the university what is it, in Nashville, Tennessee? What is that, the -- not Meharry, that's the -- [Fisk]

items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: they put Andy Kirk Clerk in charge, and that's how it became Andy Kirk Clerk and his Twelve

ctx.x: T. Holder had run away with the money and came back
to Dallas, and they had fired T. Holder and wouldn't let him come back, and they put Andy Kirk Clerk in charge, and that's how it became Andy Kirk Clerk and his Twelve -- (Clouds of Joy)
